definitions.explanation: An item or offer that provides good value for the price.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{買|か}い{得|どく}だ。
お{買|か}い{得|どく}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{買|か}い{得|どく}です。
examples.english: Buy three get one free is a good deal.

notes:
お{買|か}い{得|どく} describes something that offers good value for the money. The お prefix adds politeness and appeal. Can function as both a noun and a na-adjective.

FORMS:
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: a bargain product (na-adjective)
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}だ / お{買|か}い{得|どく}です: is a good deal

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: bargain item
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: bargain price
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: value set/combo
- お{買|か}い{得|どく}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: deals/bargain info

REGISTER:
Frequently used in advertising, store signs, and online shopping. The polite お makes it sound inviting to customers.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧: discount (specific price reduction)
- ⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: sale (event)
- ⟦{特売|とくばい}→特売：04277_tokubai⟧: special sale (often in supermarkets)
- ⟦{格安|かくやす}→格安：15125_kakuyasu⟧: extremely cheap
